scope:
3.5 clarity/mastery/homecoming browser integration.
Actual shipping HTML or ES modules via in-memory transport; only the existing
localhost diagnostic guard and asset/import locations are adapted. Controlled
chapter-ending fixtures are explicitly not human campaigns. No fake game, draw,
DOM, audio or save implementations. about:blank disallows native localStorage;
persistence is covered separately by the actual LocalStore tests with adapters.

tests.name: 3.5 identity and clean first-load contextual prompts
First exact word reveals ENTER · SAVE; no auto-submit, focus theft or repeat tutorial
The genuine sixth-card ICE opportunity teaches only when ready and preserves scarce economy
One star / 100% result explicitly shows three misses and the exact next-star requirement
Both miss and wrong-submission deficits are explained; no fake improvement is shown
Real star gains and +120 scoped PB appear once using previous values, including return from map
Practice attempts cannot beat or relabel a campaign PB; a tied repeat does not celebrate
8/16/64 model milestones, sound and visual stamp agree; 5/15/63/72 do not falsely celebrate
Continue preserves an existing multiplier without re-awarding its animation or sound
14px effective key labels, single-line long words and unclipped captions at four viewport sizes

tests.name: All seven intermediate wings celebrate, keyboard-skip safely and continue to the correct next chapter
Campaign 48 plays the complete four-second finale, lights all eight seals and opens Endless
Practice 48 and Endless never trigger or claim the campaign ending
Reduced motion immediately presents a static complete ending with usable keyboard navigation
Held Enter does not skip; Escape/button skip once and old ceremonies cannot reopen a later menu
Visibility-change fixture suspends ceremony time and resumes without progressing gameplay
Actual WebAudio finale motif schedules and cancels cleanly; independent SFX-off keeps the visual reward
Object-bound FIRE preserves input and replacement rules; frozen long words remain typable
Actual export contains compatible save schema, correctly scoped PBs and genuine word seeds
